name: vista.css
description: A Windows Vista Aero design system in pure CSS. No JavaScript. Markup-compatible with 98.css and XP.css.
notes: CSS only: no JavaScript ships with vista.css.
The window frame and taskbar are translucent backdrop-filter glass and need a background behind them.
Icons are inlined as data URIs; the type stack uses the system Segoe UI. Nothing else needs bundling.

components.name: Window
components.summary: Translucent Aero glass frame with an opaque client area. Controls are keyed off aria-label.

components.name: Window controls
components.summary: Title-bar buttons selected by aria-label. Order is free. Use Restore instead of Maximize on a maximized window.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Glossy Aero push button. .default (or :focus-visible) adds the aqua default-button glow.

components.name: Text field
components.summary: White Aero field with a hairline border and a blue focus glow. Applies to text, password, email, search, url, tel and number inputs, plus textarea.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: A native <select> skinned with a glossy button and dropdown arrow on the right.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: The real input is hidden; the immediately following <label> draws the control, so the input and label must be adjacent siblings.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Same pattern as the checkbox: hidden input plus an adjacent label. Group with a shared name.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: Glossy Aero thumb on a recessed track.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Selected tab goes flat and merges into the panel. Add .justified to stretch the tabs.
components.markup: Content of the General tab.

components.name: Group box
components.summary: Rounded hairline frame with the legend cutting through it.
components.markup: Startup

components.name: Tree view
components.summary: Collapsing uses native <details>/<summary>, so no JavaScript is needed.

components.name: Progress bar
components.summary: The inner element is the fill; give it a width. Use .marquee (empty, no inner div) for the indeterminate sweep.

components.name: Scrollbar
components.summary: Add has-scrollbar to the scrolling container. WebKit/Blink get the full Aero treatment; Firefox falls back to scrollbar-color.

components.name: Menu bar
components.summary: Submenus open on focus, or on hover when an ancestor has .can-hover. No JavaScript.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A standalone dropdown. Use has-divider for a separator, aria-disabled to disable, aria-haspopup for a caret, for a shortcut, for a gutter icon.

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: Flat buttons that light up on hover; [aria-pressed=true] gives the pressed state.

components.name: Balloon tooltip
components.summary: Default tail points up (balloon below the control); .is-top points it down; .is-left / .is-right move it sideways.

components.name: Taskbar
components.summary: Aero glass taskbar with a Start orb, task buttons and a tray clock.
